commands.command: re-review — accepted the p2, and the fix goes further than the suggested mitigation: generic http 500s never reach reason `server_error` at all (that reason is reserved for structured provider payloads; the canonical classifier deliberately folds generic 5xx and `internal server error` text into reason `timeout` as its retryable-transient bucket — see the status branch at `embedded-agent-helpers/errors.ts` ~880 and the message pipeline ~1109). so leaving `server_error` unmapped was insufficient. the mapping now uses the canonical reason only for `rate_limit`/`overloaded`/`context_overflow`, and the `timeout` badge requires the established `istimeouterror` predicate, which is false for 5xx shapes. regression cases added: http 500 → unmapped, and rate-limit-with-timeout-text precedence
commands.freeform_prompt: — accepted the P2, and the fix goes further than the suggested mitigation: generic HTTP 500s never reach reason `server_error` at all (that reason is reserved for structured provider payloads; the canonical classifier deliberately folds generic 5xx and `internal server error` text into reason `timeout` as its retryable-transient bucket — see the status branch at `embedded-agent-helpers/errors.ts` ~880 and the message pipeline ~1109). So leaving `server_error` unmapped was insufficient. The mapping now uses the canonical reason only for `rate_limit`/`overloaded`/`context_overflow`, and the `timeout` badge requires the established `isTimeoutError` predicate, which is false for 5xx shapes. Regression cases added: HTTP 500 → unmapped, and rate-limit-with-timeout-text precedence.
